limits: HTTP authentication and cookie checks do not prove graphical browser behavior.
Only the generated canary backend is exercised; installed app/custom runtime compatibility remains separate.
Catalog identity equality does not attribute concurrent user data changes.
A lost purge acknowledgement cannot prove source deletion and never yields passed acceptance.
resumption: An initial invocation returned a request error; a read-only observation succeeded, then the same durable nonce-bound verifier resumed and proved the state exactly once before cleanup.
